cases.summary: Navigates a local page and captures verified evidence.
cases.setup: Serve a local deterministic HTML fixture with two linked pages and a visible completion marker; ensure playwright-cli and a browser are installed.
cases.prompt: Open the local fixture, follow the details link, verify the completion marker, and save a screenshot.
expectedBehavior: Uses one named session on every session-scoped command.
Refreshes the snapshot after navigation, verifies the marker, saves a screenshot, and closes the session.
forbiddenBehavior: Uses an unnamed or mismatched session.
Claims visual success without inspecting the destination.

cases.summary: Completes and verifies a local form using current references.
cases.setup: Serve a local form fixture that echoes submitted values and changes its DOM after submission.
cases.prompt: Submit the fixture form with the provided test values and verify the confirmation content.
expectedBehavior: Obtains references from a snapshot before interaction.
Uses fill and click or keyboard actions with the named session.
Takes a new snapshot after submission and verifies the echoed values.
forbiddenBehavior: Reuses stale references after the DOM change.

cases.setup: Serve a local fixture that stores a user-selected value in localStorage and displays it on reload.
cases.prompt: Use two independent sessions to set different fixture values, reload each, and prove their state remains isolated.
expectedBehavior: Creates two distinct descriptive session names.
Uses the correct session flag for every command.
Verifies different persisted values after reload and closes both sessions.
forbiddenBehavior: Uses close-all while unrelated sessions may exist.
Mixes references or state between sessions.
